title: Identification received after the manual change, asset write applies
description: Same trip shape as O7.1, with two violations (HARDBRAKE at 90, HARDACCEL at 150) before the identification's claimed atSec (180). Here the identification is a delayed delivery: it claims atSec 180 but is not delivered until atSec 400, well after the trip has closed (200) and well after the scenario's manual asset-only correction step (patchAssetAssignee to driver C, orchestrated externally, before this identification is delivered). Must prove: because this identification's receipt is newer than the manual correction, the asset assignee becomes A and the trip assignee becomes A, and both violations are re-assigned to A. Must NOT change: nothing before this identification is delivered should move the trip's own assignee off null.

driver_identifications.note: delayed identification, received well after the scenario's manual correction step (external to this fixture)
